data.description:
# proxy-usage-analysis: consume actor/source/reason attribution from proxy restart logs

## Goal

Teach the proxy-usage-analysis tooling to consume the attribution markers added
by **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** (actor/source/reason on mode-switch and `--restart`
log lines) so restart attribution appears in the generated reports and the
mode-timeline classification stops being heuristic.

## Context

**LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** adds structured attribution to the proxy logs
(`source=scheduler|worker|api|manual`, `actor`, `reason`, requested `mode`) at
`set_mode()` time and to `start-proxy.sh --restart` startup output. Its AC3
proves attribution with a reproducible grep only; the reporting/parsing stack
(`.pi/skills/proxy-usage-analysis/scripts/log_parser.py`, `bucketing.py`,
`reporting.py`) and `scripts/analyze_mode_flips.py` still classify restart
causes heuristically.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `log_parser.py` parses the new attribution markers into structured fields
      on the restart/mode-switch events (absent markers degrade gracefully to
      the current behaviour).
- [ ] `bucketing.py` / `reporting.py` surface the attribution (source + actor +
      reason) in the mode-timeline / restart report sections.
- [ ] `scripts/analyze_mode_flips.py` uses `source` to classify flips instead of
      heuristics where the marker is present.
- [ ] Unit tests cover parsing of the new markers (present + absent) and the
      report output.
- [ ] A report generated from logs containing the new markers shows zero
      "unknown/ unattributable" restarts that carry a marker.
- [ ] All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including
      code comments, README, and any relevant docs site entries.
- [ ] Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- Depends on **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** landing first (markers must exist).
- Backward compatible: must still parse historical logs without the markers.

## Related work

- **LP-0MVAPNC2900145RH** — Log the requesting actor and reason for every proxy
  mode-switch / `--restart` so restarts are always attributable
  (`discovered-from`).
- **LP-0MT1EE315007AKXG** — proxy-usage-analysis: recognise manual mode switches
  in the mode timeline.
